name: Java
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a Java app, such as a Discord bot, from a jar file you upload, download, or keep in a Git repository.
startup: if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; exec java -Xms64M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=80.0 {{JAVA_ARGS}} -jar {{JARFILE}} {{APP_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Java: clones the app's Git repository, if one is set. Files already in
# the server's folder are never deleted or overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

clone() {
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
        echo "No Git repository set: upload your app's files, then start the server."
        return 0
    fi
    local url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
        echo "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" . || {
            echo "The repository couldn't be cloned: check its address, and the username and access token for a private one."
            exit 1
        }
    fi
}

clone

if [ -n "${JAR_URL:-}" ]; then
    jar="${JARFILE:-app.jar}"
    case "$jar" in /*|*..*) echo "The jar file must be a path inside the server's folder."; exit 1 ;; esac
    echo "Downloading ${JAR_URL}"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$jar")"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$jar.part" "$JAR_URL" || { rm -f "$jar.part"; echo "The jar couldn't be downloaded from ${JAR_URL}."; exit 1; }
    if ! unzip -tq "$jar.part" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$jar.part"; echo "${JAR_URL} isn't a jar file."; exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "$jar.part" "$jar"
    echo "Installed ${jar}."
    exit 0
fi
echo "Installed."

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The jar file that starts your app.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: An https link to download the jar from when the server is installed or reinstalled. Leave it empty to upload the jar or use a Git repository.

variables.name: Java options
variables.description: Extra options for Java, such as -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the app's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.
